items.text: Ŋainakineta a ŋakarikok

Akoloŋit ŋina erikakinia Moses akiduk eema ŋolo ewuakinitae Asaduku ŋina ka Acamunet, abu kios a akimyet ka kitaleu iŋes kaapei ka ŋiboro daadaŋ ŋulu aya tooma keŋ ka abu kios a akimyet ka kitaleu namuroet ka ŋiboro daadaŋ ŋulu esitiyao a nen,
apotu ŋikarikok a Ŋisirael, ŋikarikok a ŋatekerin ka ŋakarikok a ŋikabilae ŋulu apolokinito ŋituŋa ŋulu aponi kigirae inakis ŋainakineta kec.

Apotu ikes yaut ŋainakineta kec neni ke Ekapolon; yaut ikes ŋagaari ŋakanikapei ŋuna emukitoe ka ŋimoŋin ŋitomon ka ŋiarei; ŋinagaari arae ŋikarikok ŋiarei alemunito, ido alemunit ŋolo karikon emoŋ epei; apotu ikes yaut ŋainakineta ŋun inakis neni ke Ekapolon alokiŋaren eema.
Abu nai Ekapolon tolimok Moses tema,
“Tocamu akijaun ŋainakineta ŋun aneni kec, ikotere isitiyao akitiyaa ŋiticisyo alo eema a ŋolokilipet, inak ikes neni a ŋilepi, inak ŋinituŋanan ikwapei iitanitor etic keŋ.”
Aŋun abu Moses kijau ŋagaari ka ŋimoŋin aneni a ŋikarikok a Ŋisirael inak neni a ŋilepi.
Abu iŋes inak Ŋigarisoni ŋagaari ŋaarei ka ŋimoŋin ŋiomwon ikwapei eitanitotor ikes alotic kec,
ido inak Ŋimerari ŋagaari ŋaomwon ka ŋimoŋin ŋikanikauni ikwapei eitanitor etic kec. Arae Isamar lokoku ka Aron a esacaradoti iŋes apolokinit ikes daadaŋ aloticisyo kec.
Nai abu Moses nyeinak Ŋikaoti ŋagaari, kori ŋimoŋin, amaikina ikes toryoŋa ŋiboro ŋulu asegak ŋulu ainakinitae ikes akiricit.
Apotu daŋ ŋikarikok tolemut ŋainakineta aŋuna ka akitaleunio a namuroet apaki ŋina eosere iŋes, apotu ŋikarikok inakis ŋainakineta kec alokiŋaren namuroet.
Tolimok Ekapolon Moses tema, “Emaikina ŋikarikok yaut a ŋipeipei ŋainakineta kec aŋuna ka akitaleunio a namuroet, ekarikon epei yau akoloŋit apei.”
Akoloŋit ŋina esyaunan arae Nason lokoku ka Aminadab ŋolo alokabila a Yuda iŋes abu yau ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta keŋ ikes nu: Asaani apei ŋina etiyaunitae ke esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo apei. Epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu ecamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan. Elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
ŋainakineta a Nason ŋace ikes nu: Abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo apei elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo,
ekoroe ikwapei ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Nason inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Nason alokoku ka Aminadab.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋiarei, arae Nasanael lokoku ka Suar, ekarikon a ekabila a Isakar iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta keŋ ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo apei, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo apei elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe epei erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Nasanael inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Nasanael a lokoku a Suar.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋiuni arae Eliab lokoku a Elon, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Sebulon iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta a Eliab ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen apei ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo apei, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe a akimyet arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Eliab inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ka Eliab a lokoku a Elon.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋiomwon arae Elisur lokoku a Sedeur ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Ruben iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Elisur ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋin ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Elisur inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apotis kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ka Elisur a lokoku a Sedeur.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋikan arae Selumiel lokoku a Surisadai, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Simeon iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta a Selumiel ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli apei ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Selumiel inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Selumiel alokoku a Surisadai.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋikanikapei arae Elisap lokoku a Deuel, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Gad iŋes abu yau ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Elisap ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito; nituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Elisap inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Elisap alokoku a Deuel.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋikanikaarei arae Elisama lokoku ka Amiud, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila ka Epuraim iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Elisama ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Elisama inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Elisama alokoku ka Amiud.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋikanikauni, arae Gamalied lokoku a Pedasur ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Manase iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ,

Ŋainakineta a Gamaliel ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋun ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋin, arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Elisama inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta a Gamaliel alokoku a Pedasur.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋikanikaomwon, arae Abidan lokoku a Gideoni, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Benjamin iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Abidan ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit,

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Abidan inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa, ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ka Abidan alokoku a Gideoni.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋitomon arae Aieser lokoku ka Amisadai, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Dan iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Aieser ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋun ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit
ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Aieser inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ka Amisadai
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋitomon ka epei arae Pagiel lokoku ka Okiran, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila ka Aser iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Pagiel ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ akilo, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil abu Pagiel inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Erae ŋun ŋainakineta a Pagiel alokoku ka Okiran.
Ani epete ŋirwa ŋitomon ka ŋiarei arae Aira lokoku ke Enan, ekarikon a ŋituŋa a ekabila a Naputali iŋes abu inak ŋainakineta keŋ.

Ŋainakineta ka Aira ikes nu: Asaani ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina arae apotis keŋ apei kilo ka atutubet, abesen ŋina etiyaunitae a esilipa ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ apei kilo, epimitae ŋiboro alotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan, elelebikinitae nasaani ka nabesen ŋakirya ŋuna ajokak ŋuna eguritoe ka akimyet, arae ŋin ainakinet ŋina a ŋikinyom,
abakuli ŋina etiyaunitae a egolid ŋina aapiyarit apotis keŋ atutubet apei a akilo, elelebikinitae ekinyate nabakuli ŋin,
etaok, emesek, ikale ŋinimesek ŋini arae apolou keŋ ekaru epei, arae ŋun ŋainakinet ŋuna epeyo;
ekoroe erae ainakinet aŋuna ka asecit

ka aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, abu Aira inak ŋimoŋin ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋikan, ŋikorwa ŋikan ka ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋikan ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta ka Aira alokoku ke Enan.

Erae nu ŋainakineta ŋuna apotu ŋikarikok a Ŋisirael inakis Ekapolon akoloŋit ŋina eosere ka etaleunere namuroet: Ŋasaani ŋatomon ka ŋaarei ŋuna etiyaunitae ke esilipa, ŋabesenio ŋatomon ka ŋaarei ŋuna etiyaunitae ke esilipa, ŋabakuli ŋatomon ka ŋaarei ŋuna etiyaunitae ke egolid,

arae apotis a ŋinasaani apei kilo ka atutubet ka ŋinabesen aapiyarit apotis keŋ apei kilo, arae apotis a esilipa a ŋolo etiyaunitere ŋiboro ŋul daadaŋ ŋakiloi ŋatomoniarei ka ŋakanikauni, epimitae ŋiboro ŋul lotyae a ŋicekelya a ŋulu acamunito ŋituŋa daadaŋ isitiyao anakibois a ŋina asegan;

ŋabakuli ŋatomon ka ŋaarei ŋuna etiyaunitae ke egolid, ŋuna eleleba ekinyate, aapiyarit apotis a ŋinabakuli atutubet apei a akilo ka arae ŋakiloi apotis a egolid a daadaŋ a ŋolo etiyaunitere ŋabakuli ŋun akilo apei;

ŋibaren daadaŋ ŋulu arae ŋainakineta ŋuna epeyo, arae ŋimoŋin ŋitomon ka ŋiarei, ŋimeesekin ŋitomon ka ŋiarei, ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋitomon ka ŋiarei ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei ka ŋainakineta kec ŋuna a ŋikinyom; ŋikorwa ŋitomon ka ŋiarei ŋulu arae ŋainakineta aŋuna ka asecit;

ŋibaren daadaŋ ŋulu arae aŋuna ka amuronot a ŋina ke ekisil, arae ŋimoŋin ŋatomoniarei ka ŋiomwon, ŋimeesekin ŋatomonikanikapei, ŋikorwa ŋatomonikanikapei, ŋikaalei ŋulumesekin ŋatomonikanikapei ŋulu arae apolou kec ekaru epei. Arae ŋun ŋainakineta aŋuna ka akitaleunio namuroet kedaun akios iŋes ka akimyet.

Apaki ŋina alomarya Moses loeema ŋolokilipet akirwor ke Ekapolon, abu iŋes kiira etoil irworo neni keŋ alokidiama akibois ŋina ka akisyonio ŋina ayai kidiama Asaduku ŋina ka Acamunet, abunit etoil ŋol alokidiŋ Ŋisubuna ŋulu a ŋabebenuk ŋuluarei kirwor neni keŋ.
